presets.name: Game + all mods
presets.description: Everything unlocked. Thule Moon Academy with the gunship and CIS vehicles, the Thule Power mode (a powerup in the middle that changes every 60 s) and reworked waves. Conquest with AI players (pick AI in the lobby with RB), CIS spider walkers and wheeled tank, Republic walker and transport, new specials. Online games use this mode: everyone needs the same launcher version.

presets.name: Original game
presets.description: The game as it was on the Xbox, with no mods (widescreen and resolution settings still apply).
